title.zh: Robinhood第三季度营收符合预期，预测市场收入激增而加密收入下降55%
title.en: Robinhood Q3 Revenue Meets Estimates as Prediction Market Revenue Surges and Cry

current_state.zh:
Robinhood公布2026年第三季度营收14.24亿美元，同比增长12%，与14.2亿美元的市场预期基本一致；但摊薄每股收益0.51美元，低于0.56美元的预期。预测市场事件合约收入增长逾六倍至1.73亿美元，而加密交易收入下降55%至1.2亿美元。

本季度事件合约收入1.73亿美元已超过加密交易收入1.2亿美元，显示公司收入结构正从加密现货交易向事件合约倾斜。Robinhood同时将2026年调整后运营费用与股权激励指引上限从27.75亿美元下调至27.5亿美元，下限维持在26.75亿美元。

加密名义交易量下降38%至500亿美元，而事件合约交易量增长逾七倍至164亿份。Robinhood Chain在主网运行的首个季度录得逾800亿美元DEX交易量和超过5000万美元网络费用；净利润下降14%至4.76亿美元，调整后EBITDA增长9%至8.08亿美元，每股收益中包含主要与Robinhood Ventures Fund I相关的每股0.07美元未实现亏损。
current_state.en: Robinhood's Q3 2026 revenue of $1.424B met estimates but EPS missed at $0.51, with crypto transaction revenue down 55% to $120M, prediction-market revenue up over sixfold to $173M, and its Robinhood Chain mainnet logging $80B in DEX volume and $50M+ in fees in its first quarter.

updates.background_zh: Robinhood Chain是一条基于Arbitrum Dedicated Blockchains构建的免许可、兼容以太坊的Layer-2网络；Robinhood于2026年7月1日宣布其公共主网上线，称其旨在将传统市场、加密资产与真实世界资产连接到同一网络。Robinhood在其现有券商应用内提供预测市场事件合约，该领域美国最大的平台包括Kalshi与Polymarket。
updates.background_en: Robinhood Chain is a permissionless, Ethereum-compatible Layer-2 built on Arbitrum Dedicated Blockchains; Robinhood announced the public mainnet launch on July 1, 2026, describing it as a network connecting traditional markets, crypto and real-world assets. Robinhood offers prediction-market event contracts inside its existing brokerage app, a segment where Kalshi and Polymarket are the largest US venues.
updates.market_impact_zh: 加密交易收入下降55%、名义成交量下降38%，反映美国最大零售券商之一所面对的散户加密现货需求走弱，这一信号会通过订单流与成交量渠道传导至依赖美国零售交易的现货交易场所和做市商。另一方面，Robinhood Chain首季800亿美元DEX成交量和逾5000万美元网络费用，使部分链上活动与费用流经基于Arbitrum的Layer-2生态。
updates.market_impact_en: The 55% drop in crypto transaction revenue and 38% decline in notional volume point to softer retail crypto spot demand at one of the largest US retail brokerages, a signal that transmits through order-flow and volume channels to spot venues and market makers reliant on US retail activity. Separately, the $80 billion in first-quarter DEX volume and $50 million-plus in network fees on Robinhood Chain route onchain activity and fee flows through an Arbitrum-based Layer-2 ecosystem.
